dedupe_keys.name: statistics estonia census 2021 rel2021 dwellings and buildings with water toilet and central heating and place of work tables by municipality

description: Statistics Estonia publishes the results of its register-based Population and Housing Census 2021 (REL2021) in a PxWeb database, next to folders for the 2000 and 2011 censuses. The dwellings folder holds 14 tables on buildings containing dwellings and on conventional dwellings, by type of building, time of construction, number of rooms, area, occupancy and presence of comfort characteristics: water supply system, bathing facilities, toilet and central heating. Coverage runs from the whole country through settlement regions and counties to each municipality and city. On 31 December 2021 the country had 732,836 conventional dwellings, of which 656,458 had a water supply system, 640,515 a toilet and 490,514 central heating, while 241,002 lacked central heating. A work migration folder cross tabulates employed persons by place of residence and location of place of work down to administrative units. Format and access: free tables in PX, CSV and XLSX and a PxWeb JSON API, no registration. Licence (read on the provider page on 2026-09-28): CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: the census is derived from registers, and the unknown category is shown separately for each amenity. Simulation uses: municipal water, sanitation and heating gaps, housing age for retrofit and heat demand models, and home to work flows for transport demand. Related records: the Estonian building register and the Estonia 3D building models.
